speciality.label: Wound care dressings
speciality.otcText: National position (read at source, 20/11/2026): NHS England policy guidance, "Items which should not routinely be prescribed in primary care" (published 3 August 2023, last updated 19 August 2025), lists no wound dressings, dressing packs or other wound care products, so there is no national low-priority or over-the-counter recommendation for this market. Local wound care formularies set which brands are used; this ICB's formulary has not been read at source.
speciality.hospitalEmpty: Secondary Care Medicines Data records what trust pharmacies issue, and no product carrying this brand's name is in it. Hospital use of dressings that reaches wards by other routes is not in any open dataset the Hub reads, so no hospital figure is shown.

market: BNF-code section 2003 (wound management and other dressings, appliance list), primary care items
marketNote: The market is every primary care item in BNF-code section 2003, which includes sterile dressing packs (Dressit and Nurse It are two of the largest lines), wound drainage bags and other appliances as well as dressings. A brand's share is of that whole section, not of dressings alone.

hospital.scope: Medicines issued by NHS trust pharmacies (pharmacy stock control), England, Secondary Care Medicines Data. Indicative cost at list or reimbursement price, not what trusts pay. Only products whose dm+d name carries the brand can be attributed to a brand; generic-named products cannot, so there is no hospital share of the market. Provisional data after March 2026.
